entries.title: Job 36:1
segments: ¶And Elihu proceeded and said,

entries.title: Job 36:2
segments: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet words for +God.

entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Creator.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: For truly my words shall be no falsehood: one perfect in knowledge is with thee.

entries.title: Job 36:5
segments: ¶Lo, *God is mighty, but despiseth not [any]; mighty in strength of understanding:

entries.title: Job 36:6
segments: He saveth not the wicked alive; but he doeth justice to the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 36:7
segments: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne doth he even set them for ever; and they are exalted.

entries.title: Job 36:8
segments: And if, bound in fetters, they be held in cords of affliction,

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions, because they have increased.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: And he openeth their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

entries.title: Job 36:11
segments: If they hearken and serve [him], they shall accomplish their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: But if they hearken not, they shall pass away by the sword, and expire without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: But the godless in heart heap up anger; they cry not when he bindeth them:

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: Their soul dieth in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments: ¶But he delivereth the afflicted in his affliction, and openeth their ear in [their] oppression.

entries.title: Job 36:16
segments: Even so would he have allured thee out of the jaws of distress into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and the supply of thy table [would be] full of fatness.

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: But thou art full of the judgments of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold [on thee].

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: Because there is wrath, [beware] lest it take thee away through chastisement: then a great ransom could not avail thee.

entries.title: Job 36:19
segments: Will he esteem thy riches? Not gold, nor all the resources of strength!

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: Desire not the night, when peoples are cut off from their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments: Take heed, turn not to iniquity; for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:22
segments: Lo, *God is exalted in his power: who teacheth as he?

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who hath appointed him his way? or who hath said, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: ¶Remember that thou magnify his work, which men celebrate.

entries.title: Job 36:25
segments: All men look at it; man beholdeth [it] afar off.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: Lo, *God is great, and we comprehend [him] not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments: For he draweth up the drops of water: they distil in rain from the vapour which he formeth,

entries.title: Job 36:28
segments: Which the skies pour down [and] drop upon man abundantly.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments: But can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, [or] the crashing of his pavilion?

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments: Lo, he spreadeth his light around him, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: For with them he judgeth the peoples; he giveth food in abundance.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: [His] hands he covereth with lightning, and commandeth it where it is to strike.

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments: His thundering declareth concerning him; the cattle even, concerning its coming.
